en:
## New Features

- Subagents can now roll back their own file changes; only the subagent is paused, its parent and siblings keep working
- Default and Summary rows in the model menu now show which provider serves the resolved model

## Bug Fixes

- Model dropdowns on mobile no longer disappear under the virtual keyboard, and touch devices no longer pop the keyboard just by opening the menu
- Releasing a takeover of a suspended foreground subagent now hands the result back to the parent immediately instead of waiting forever
- Editing history of a subagent paused for manual input no longer fails with "did not stop after being interrupted"
- Project archive sync no longer freezes the server for seconds on long-running narrators with many messages
- Large project archive exports no longer block other requests while they run
- Retrying an image generation clears stale progress cards and keeps already produced output
- Stream watchdog no longer aborts healthy streams, and stalled streams are retried
- Reasoning streams from OpenRouter-style relays are no longer dropped
- Reasoning-effort menus now follow the tiers the gateway reports for every NUG channel
- Rolling back history restores files to the correct state, and skips the confirmation when no file is affected

## Other Changes

- Models without a known context window now assume 272k tokens instead of 128k
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 子代理支持独立回退文件改动，只暂停该子代理，父叙述者与其他子代理照常运行
- 模型菜单的「默认」「摘要」行会显示实际模型所属的供应商

## 修复

- 移动端模型下拉框不再被软键盘遮挡，触屏设备打开菜单时也不会自动弹出键盘
- 结束对挂起中前台子代理的接管后，结果会立即交还父叙述者，不再无限等待
- 编辑手动接管挂起中的子代理历史时，不再报「中断后仍未停止」
- 消息量大的叙述者长时间工作时，项目归档同步不再让服务器卡顿数秒
- 导出大型项目归档期间不再阻塞其他请求
- 生图重试会清理残留的进度卡片，并保留已生成的内容
- 流看门狗不再误杀正常的流，卡住的流会自动重试
- 兼容 OpenRouter 风格中继的推理流，不再整段丢失
- 所有 NUG 渠道的推理强度菜单均以网关上报的档位为准
- 回滚历史时文件恢复到正确状态，未影响文件时不再弹确认框

## 其他变更

- 未知上下文窗口的模型默认按 272k 计算（原为 128k）
